name: utuvo-guard
description: Guard / 防呆閘 — checks every Bash command before it runs and stops the ones people fear an AI agent doing: rm -rf on your home or Documents, a force push to main, git reset --hard over uncommitted work, committing .env or private keys, DROP TABLE / DELETE without WHERE, erasing a disk. Protects folders you list (photos, thesis, masters) from being deleted, moved, overwritten or converted in place. Add `# guard-ok: <reason>` to override; everything is logged to ~/.local/log/utuvo-guard.log.

language.title: Language 語言
language.description: auto follows your system language (LC_ALL / LANG); zh-TW = 繁體中文; en = English.

protectedFolders.title: Protected folders 受保護的資料夾
protectedFolders.description: Comma-separated folders whose files may be read and copied out but never deleted, moved, overwritten or converted in place, e.g. ~/Pictures/Photos Library, ~/Documents/Thesis. 用逗號分隔；也可以寫在 ~/.config/utuvo-guard/protected.txt（一行一個）。Folders named master / masters / 母帶 are always protected for audio files.
